# Support

Mordex Components is a free project kept by one volunteer. This page tells you where to go for each kind of help.

## Ask a question

Open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Mordex-Components/issues/new?template=question.yml). Say what you want to do and what you tried. Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Mordex-Components/issues?q=is%3Aissue) first. Someone may have asked already.

## Report a bug

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Mordex-Components/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include the package version, your Windows, .NET and Visual Studio versions, and the steps to repeat the problem. A small project that shows the problem is the best report.

## Request a feature

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Mordex-Components/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Describe the problem first.

## Report a security problem

Do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability report](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Mordex-Components/security/advisories/new) and read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Please never post

Secrets, license keys, connection strings or real customer data. None of them are needed to fix a problem, and issues are public.

## What to expect

- Help is given by a volunteer in spare time. Replies are best effort, and there is no guaranteed response time.
- There is no phone, email or chat support.
- Only the latest release is supported. Please update before you report a bug.
- Please be kind. The [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) applies in every issue and pull request.

If you want to help others, answering a question in an issue is a good way to contribute. To send a change, read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
